Elongated_Caudata_Spine.description: An extensively elongated, highly flexible spine featuring dozens of additional vertebrae. It allows for sinuous, sweeping lateral movements essential for rapid aquatic navigation and wriggling through dense mud.

Limbless_Gymnophiona_Core.description: A completely limbless, cylindrical frame composed almost entirely of tightly interlocking vertebrae and heavy axial musculature. It is a biological battering ram designed purely to force its way blindly through compacted subterranean soil.

Ossified_Ceratophryid_Chassis.description: A ridiculously wide, heavily ossified skeleton supporting massive bulk. It utterly abandons the leaping modifications of standard anurans to become an immovable, heavily armored ambush predator half-buried in the leaf litter.

Flattened_Pipa_Frame.description: An impossibly flattened, pancake-like skeletal structure lacking a tongue or vocal cords. It lies perfectly flush against the murky riverbed, completely indistinguishable from a piece of decaying deadwood.

Arboreal_Hylid_Skeleton.description: An incredibly delicate, hollow-boned skeleton optimized entirely for vertical mobility. The pectoral girdle is heavily modified to absorb the tremendous shock of constantly leaping between impossibly high canopy branches.

Goliath_Riparian_Bulk.description: A gigantic, heavily muscled anuran frame capable of reaching the size of a small dog. Pushes the absolute extreme limits of amphibian respiration, trading agility for the raw power to wrestle aquatic megafauna.

Paedomorphic_Aquatic_Core.description: A skeletal structure permanently localized in a juvenile, highly cartilaginous state. While physically softer than adult bone, it retains staggering regenerative capabilities, capable of rebuilding severed limbs flawlessly.

Troglobitic_Cave_Chassis.description: A ghostly pale, exceedingly fragile frame utterly depleted of pigment and unnecessary bone density. Evolved entirely in pitch-black subterranean lakes, it sacrifices all physical defenses for absolute sensory supremacy.

Torrent_Dwelling_Frame.description: A dense, muscularly widened chassis designed explicitly to cling desperately to submerged rocks in violently raging rapids. Its sheer mass prevents it from being swept away by torrential currents.

Inflating_Brevicipitid_Core.description: A highly spherical, stout core possessing massively redundant lung capacity. When threatened, the entity violently inhales, inflating its body like a balloon to wedge itself immovably within rocky crevices.
